notes.title: TopSpin Patch 6.0
notes.content:
Get ready for some exciting updates! A patch is scheduled for release today, February 17th, bringing new content to TopSpin!

Patch Highlights:
[olist]
 Added Season 6 Center Court Pass and Pro Shop content
 Updated serve animations for Keys, Agassi, and Sampras
 Added 3 new Tennis Styles and 10 new Pro Outfits to the Pro Shop
 Added "Net Points Won" to the Statistics screen in the Pause Menu
 Updated the logic for entering the Player Selection screen in Exhibition and 2K Tour modes to randomly select default Pro Outfits
 General bug fixes and improvements
[/olist]

This patch is scheduled for release today, February 17th, at 1 PM GMT / 2 PM CET / 5 AM PST!

The excitement continues with the launch of Season 6 shortly after, on February 18th at 6 AM GMT / 7 AM CET / 10 PM PST (Due to time zones, this will be February 17th PST).

For the best possible experience, we strongly encourage everyone to update to Patch 6.0 as soon as it's available.

See you on the court!

notes.title: TopSpin 2K25 Stability Patch
notes.content: This update fixes a rare issue where certain users would not be able to load into Online modes or MyCAREER Laver Cup.

notes.title: TopSpin 2K25 Season 5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
What’s New:

 Added statistics between points to show various stats such as winners, unforced errors, aces, longest rally (and more) during matches
 Updated swing animations for Carlos Alcaraz (forehand, backhand) and Taylor Fritz (backhand)
 Added ability for AI-controlled pro players in MyCAREER to use alternate outfits in tournaments
 Added new World Tour League rewards exclusive to Season 5
 Added new G.O.A.T. objectives and rewards exclusive to Season 5
 Added new Tennis Styles and Pro Outfits in the Pro Shop

Gameplay Balancing Update:

 Updated the speed of the Timing Meter to make shots performed with a low Rally Energy meter and during long rallies harder to time perfectly
 Increased the chance of errors on Flat Power shots performed with a low Rally Energy meter and during long rallies when the timing isn't perfect
 Slightly increased the chance of errors on all other groundstrokes performed with a low Rally Energy meter and during long rallies when the timing isn't perfect
 Updated logic to make the Rally Energy meter deplete faster when using Flat Power shots repeatedly during a rally
 Made Slice Power shots consume less Rally Energy
 Updated the speed of the Timing Meter to make volleys a little easier to time perfectly, especially with a high Volley attribute or when the incoming ball is slow
 Updated the Focus Service, Advanced Serve Berserker, Diesel Server and Spin Serve Master skills to make them more noticeable
 Updated attributes for Carlos Alcaraz, Roger Federer and Andy Murray

Gameplay Stability Update:

 Game stability and server improvements

notes.title: TopSpin 2K25 Season 2 is Live!
notes.content:
Season 2 of TopSpin 2K25 transports you to the green, meticulously manicured lawns of the prestigious Grand Slam® venue The Championships, Wimbledon in London, United Kingdom. There’s a lot coming in Season 2, including: Jannik Sinner as a new, free, playable pro, content and rewards from Gucci and a brand-new Centre Court Pass, presented by American Express, which features thematic content, pro outfits, cosmetics from top brands, and more. With TopSpin 2K25’s non-expiring Seasons, you can play at your own pace and complete a Centre Court Pass even after a new one releases! For the next eight weeks, soak in all that Season 2 has to offer as you gear up for The Championships, Wimbledon. 

[previewyoutube=Xk9EkHK92oQ;full][/previewyoutube]
TAKE TO THE STAGE AT CENTRE COURT
All year long, TopSpin 2K25 will follow the real-life Tour calendar and spotlight featured tournaments throughout each Season. For Season 2, the focus is on Centre Court at The Championships, Wimbledon.

The Championships, also known as Wimbledon, is the oldest tennis tournament in the world. The only major still played on grass, Wimbledon provides the ultimate tennis experience. Similar to the real-life event, the in-game experience will follow the same historic tradition of a strictly all-white dress code for players. But don’t fret, Centre Court Pass Season 2 is jam-packed with earnable white cosmetics that are perfect for the occasion!

JANNIK SINNER JOINS THE PLAYABLE PRO ROSTER
One of the most highly requested pros to be added to TopSpin 2K25 is entering the playable pro roster in Season 2. Jannik Sinner, the highest-ranked Italian tennis player in history, and current World Number 1, will be joining the list of renowned players available for anyone to play as in 2K Tour and Exhibition modes. Jannik will make his debut alongside his custom-designed Gucci duffle bag that he initially appeared with during Wimbledon 2023.

Jannik’s entry to the game will be spotlighted with his own Community Challenge. Beginning June 20, if the TopSpin 2K25 Community can achieve 22,000 collective matches played as Sinner in 2K Tour and Exhibition modes by the end of Season 2 on August 14 at 11 PM PT, every player will earn Jannik Sinner's AO24 top in-game!*

GUCCI HAS ENTERED THE CHAT
TopSpin 2K25 has partnered with Gucci for Season 2 to bring players a brand new, bespoke Gucci-themed venue, Gucci tournaments for players to take part in in World Tour, and exclusive Gucci cosmetics to earn ONLY during respective game weeks.

INTRODUCING: THE G-COURT
Season 2 welcomes a new free Court, called the G-Court, made in collaboration with Gucci. Set against the majestic backdrop of Italy, the G-Court features a grass court and brutalist concrete architecture. The G-Court is playable in Exhibition Mode and also in World Tour for a limited-time through the Gucci Tennis Cup.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841796/8ae0b45f7b3d3f4fb1c9a047b6471a7ee8e50362.jpg

GUCCI TENNIS CUP
Prepare for 4 weeks of exclusive Gucci rewards in the Gucci Tennis Cup in World Tour, which will run every two weeks during Season 2! Players who win a match during each game week will receive Gucci cosmetics for both their male and female MyPLAYERs from the upcoming Gucci Tennis Capsule collection.** 
But wait, there’s more! Players who win a World Tour match in each of the 4 weeks that the tournament is running will earn a collection complete reward of Gucci Ace sneakers!

The Gucci Tennis Cup will be available in World Tour during the following dates: 

 June 27th to July 4th, 2024
 July 11th to July 18th, 2024
 July 25th to August 1st, 2024
 August 8th to August 15th, 2024

GUCCI TENNIS CAPSULE COLLECTION 
Tennis fashion has never looked so good. Gucci is releasing their tennis-inspired Gucci Tennis collection in TopSpin 2K25. The collection features cosmetics for male and female MyPLAYERs including white shorts and skirts matched with tank tops or knitted polo shirts, all adorned with the iconic green-red-green Web stripe synonymous with the House. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841796/291f3603df294f5b67b9cf9f86e274f5cc61e890.jpg

The Gucci collection is an exclusive drop that is only earnable and cannot be acquired from the Pro Shop. The only way to get your hands on the collection is through winning matches in World Tour during the Gucci Tennis Cup.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841796/baa6052ff80e615bd4bbea3caaee85af48864474.jpg

EARN ALT-ERA SERENA WILLIAMS
The 7-time Women’s singles Champion of Wimbledon and record-holder of the longest ranked World No. 1 by the Women’s Tennis Association, Serena Williams, takes the spot as the Season 2 Alt Era Pro. In Season 2, you can unlock an alt era version of Serena in 2 of her signature looks by reaching Free Tier 5 and Free Tier 50 of the Season 2 Centre Court Pass.

SERENA WILLIAMS GRASS 15 OUTFIT

A true representation of Wimbledon attire, and her 2015 Wimbledon winning look, Serena’s Grass 15 Outfit features a sleek white Nike dress with a fitted bodice and flared skirt, accented by a racerback design. Unlock this look at Season 2’s Free Tier 5 and you’ll be Wimbledon-ready!

SERENA WILLIAMS US 16 OUTFIT

Serena’s US Open 2016 outfit certainly didn’t disappoint when it comes to her long list of legendary fashion looks that she has stepped out in over her tennis career. Complete with neon pink arm warmers, this ‘80s-inspired white and pink ensemble is available to unlock at Season 2’s Free Tier 50.

50 TIERS OF NEW REWARDS, PRESENTED BY AMERICAN EXPRESS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841796/2473e6d65b948ea1e6f7d5f073241a5fd0c62390.jpg

Every version of the TopSpin 2K25 Centre Court Pass will feature 50 reward tiers, 13 of which will feature free rewards. In the Season 2 Centre Court Pass, there are 40 free rewards and 102 premium rewards.

AMERICAN EXPRESS FREE REWARDS

Presented by American Express, Centre Court Pass Season 2 is jam-packed with American Express-themed rewards including cosmetics and accessories perfectly suited to the dress code at Wimbledon. Take a look at some of the free American Express rewards you can unlock in Season 2 below:


 Tier 1 American Express Blue and White Racket
 Tier 13 American Express Wristbands
 Tier 31 American Express Zip Up Jacket
 Tier 39 American Express White Breeze Sweatpants and Tights
 Tier 42 American Express Racquet Bag
 Tier 46 American Express Global White Shorts and Skirt

PREMIUM ALT PRO OUTFITS & REWARDS

Transform two of tennis’ most prominent contemporary stars, Iga Świątek and Matteo Berrettini, with their Premium Centre Court Pass outfit rewards. Players who have purchased the Premium Centre Court Pass for Season 2 will be able to earn and unlock the Swiatek US 23 #2 Outfit at Tier 30 and the Berrettini US 23 Outfit at Tier 50.
There are a total of 102 premium rewards you can earn in Season 2; take a look at some of the featured rewards below:

 Tier 7 HEAD Radical Racquet Bag XL
 Tier 12 New Balance Fresh Foam X CT-Rally
 Tier 26 NikeCourt Dri-FIT ADV Slam Men's Tennis Top and Women's Tennis Tank Top
 Tier 36 Green and Purple Shorts and Purple Green and White Tights
 Tier 43 On Court Tank

NEW ITEMS IN THE PRO SHOP

Season 2 will see a host of new items dropping in the Pro Shop Seasonal Store, from brands including: 

 Adidas
 Asics
 Boss
 Castore
 Goodr
 Lacoste
 New Balance
 Nike
 On Running
 Original Penguin
 Tecnifibre
 Uniqlo
 Wilson

Additionally, there will be brand-new Signature Style  Animations and Alt Pro Outfits dropping in the Pro Shop in Season 2, so your MyPLAYER can simulate the unique styles of your favorite pros and look the part at the same time!

Get ready to dive into an action-packed Season 2 of TopSpin 2K25, brimming with exciting features, exclusive rewards, and so much more! 

* Limit 1 reward per 2K Account. If community target is met, reward can be redeemed in-game via the boot screen promo. Terms apply.
** Gucci Tennis Cup requires internet connection and 2K Account. Console online play requires separate paid subscription. Terms apply.
